== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|A [[Subspace]] warp is a visual phenomenon characterized by swirling, multicolored patterns that resemble [[rainbow light]], flowers, or roses. These distortions manifest as tears or ruptures in the fabric of reality, allowing for travel between real space and [[Subspace]]. While they can be used as a means of transportation, such as for diving into [[Subspace]] or performing micro-dives, they can also be utilized as weapons by creating short-lived ruptures. The appearance and stability of these warps are often linked to the use of a [[Subspace Drive]], though they can also be triggered by spells or appear spontaneously. Large-[[scale]] warps can grow to sizes capable of swallowing planets, and they may serve as exit points for entire fleets or individual ships. Navigating through these distortions involves significant risks, including mechanical strain on a vessel's drive, the potential for being caught in violent storms caused by atmospheric displacement, or becoming trapped in the tension of a warp. Furthermore, exposure to [[Subspace]] can lead to physical distortions for unprotected beings or a psychological phenomenon known as [[Subspace madness]], where individuals become obsessed with the patterns seen within the dimension.}}
